correctness.rationale: The graph is precisely F_5[t]/(t^2-2) with degree twelve. A deterministic matching on all 515 nonempty faces forms 225 disjoint codimension-one pairs, and explicit reversal of paired Hasse covers yields a directed acyclic graph on all 515 nodes. Exactly one critical zero-cell and 64 critical two-cells prove the integral wedge homotopy type. The full automorphism-group order 600 follows from the fifteen maximal five-clique lines and the 100-element kernel of the three-direction action; every one of the 600 semilinear affine maps independently preserves graph edges. Two independent formulas agree on all 600 exact rational homology Lefschetz traces, conjugacy classes and Fourier coefficients. Modular boundary elimination at 2,3,101 independently matches homology, but is not used as proof of integral homotopy. Rational quotient statements follow by averaging and finite-group transfer.

value.rationale: Paley(25) is the first nontrivial three-direction extension-field Paley example and also a canonical Latin-square strongly regular graph. The known 64-dimensional field-homology result does not identify its integral homotopy type or whether that homology representation is homogeneous. The exact 16-class character, square-versus-nonsquare Fourier multiplicity split (2 vs 3), and the drop from four translation-invariant classes to zero full-group invariants distinguish natural symmetry quotients and provide usable structural data beyond the known Betti count. This is not an arbitrary parameter substitution.
